Question 11(c) [15 marks]: Explain how the range of occupations in Athens helps us to understand society in this period. Support your response using evidence from Source L and other relevant sources.
[Pericles] boldly suggested to the people projects for great constructions, and designs for works which would call many arts into play and involve long periods of time, in order that the stay-at- homes, no . . . less than the sailors and sentinels and soldiers, might have a pretext for getting a beneficial share of the public wealth.
Source L: Plutarch, Pericles 12 Perseus Digital Library, Editor-in-Chief Gregory R Crane, Tufts University http://www.perseus.tufts.edu

13–15 marks: Provides a well-developed and accurate explanation relevant to the question | Integrates evidence from the source provided and other relevant sources to support the response | Communicates ideas and information logically using appropriate historical terms and concepts
